value.name: Lucia defends mother's house
value.description: Lucia argues that the house is a living memory of their mother’s dreams and sacrifices and refuses to let Daniel erase that meaning.
evidence: Lucia: "How can you dismiss our mother's love so easily, Daniel? This house is not just a burden; it's a living memory of her dreams and sacrifices, and I refuse to let you erase that without truly understanding her wishes!"

value.name: Asha mediates the family dispute
value.description: Asha acknowledges both sides and suggests that Lucia’s discovery could help the family understand their mother’s intentions more deeply.
evidence: Asha: "Everyone, I understand the weight of these emotions—Daniel, your concerns are valid, but Lucia's discovery opens a door to understanding our mother’s intentions more deeply; perhaps we can find a way to honor her legacy while also addressing the practicalities at hand."

value.name: Lucia frames house as family essence
value.description: Lucia insists that selling the house would mean losing their family identity and their mother’s spirit.
evidence: Lucia: "Can’t you see, Daniel? This isn't just about practicality—it's about preserving the very essence of who we are as a family! Our mother’s love is woven into these walls, and if we sell this house, we risk losing her spirit along with it!"

value.name: Lucia urges preserving the house
value.description: Lucia says their mother intended the house to remain a cherished sanctuary for memories and asks them to explore every possibility before letting it go.
evidence: Lucia: "I believe she intended for us to cherish this place, to keep it alive as a sanctuary for our memories. We owe it to her—and to ourselves—to explore every possibility before we let go of what she held dear."

value.name: Asha proposes honoring legacy and stability
value.description: Asha urges Daniel to imagine the house still serving as a refuge and to explore options that balance their mother’s vision with financial stability.
evidence: Asha: "Lucia's passion highlights the heart of this matter; I urge you, Daniel, to take a moment and envision a future where this house can still serve as a refuge for your family—let’s explore options that honor your mother's vision while securing the stability you seek."

value.name: Daniel insists on financial urgency
value.description: Daniel argues that they cannot delay because every moment spent debating the house threatens the future he has worked for, and practicality must come first.
evidence: Daniel: "Exploring options is one thing, but we can't lose sight of the urgency here—every moment we waste thinking about this house is another moment I risk losing everything I've worked for; practicality has to come first!"

value.name: Rosa begins to speak
value.description: Rosa starts to speak, but her line is cut off before she can state her position.
